title: Why Your Search Dies In Week Three
author: Steve Dalton
hook: Job searches die in week three.

beats.phrase: Job searches die in week three.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a long burnt orange line running across the cream stage that breaks off sharply a third of the way along

beats.change_only: a burnt orange arrow pushes hard against the break in the line

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a scatter of loose blank monochrome cards drifting apart on the cream stage

beats.change_only: the drifting cards spread further apart across the stage

beats.scene: WIDE: ten small monochrome cutout figures in a row on the cream stage, four of them edged burnt orange

beats.change_only: the four orange edged figures fade back to plain monochrome

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a wide gap of bare cream paper between two groups of blank cards, a broken burnt orange stroke across it

beats.change_only: the broken orange stroke thins until it nearly disappears

beats.scene: MEDIUM: three blank monochrome cards standing upright in a tight row on the cream stage, each edged burnt orange

beats.change_only: a burnt orange bracket closes around the three cards

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the oversized monochrome hand setting a third blank card down beside two others

beats.change_only: the hand lifts away leaving the three cards standing

beats.scene: MEDIUM: three monochrome cutout figures standing evenly spaced on the cream stage on one burnt orange band

beats.change_only: the burnt orange band under the three figures thickens

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: one blank note on the cream stage with three short burnt orange strokes stacked on it

beats.change_only: a small burnt orange tick appears beside the stacked strokes

beats.phrase: More than three, you drop things.
beats.scene: WIDE: eight blank cards crowded on the cream stage with two of them falling off the bottom edge

beats.change_only: three more cards tip off the bottom edge of the frame

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome hourglass on the cream stage inside a burnt orange marker circle

beats.change_only: a burnt orange arc sweeps once around the hourglass

beats.scene: WIDE: a row of identical monochrome marks across the cream stage with every seventh one burnt orange

beats.change_only: every orange mark in the row thickens at once

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure on the cream stage with a wavering burnt orange line above them

beats.change_only: the wavering line above the figure straightens out

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: one blank card on the cream stage with a burnt orange arrow pointing back toward the viewer

beats.change_only: the arrow on the card turns to point outward instead

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a blank monochrome card on the cream stage faded to pale grey, a thin burnt orange line trailing off it

beats.change_only: the pale grey card slides toward the edge of the stage

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome hand lifting one pale grey card clear off the cream stage

beats.change_only: the lifted card fades out of the frame entirely

beats.scene: MEDIUM: an empty gap in a row of three cards on the cream stage, a burnt orange bracket marking the gap

beats.change_only: a fresh blank card drops into the empty gap

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single burnt orange loop stroke drawn closed on bare cream paper

beats.change_only: the orange loop thickens into a solid ring

beats.scene: WIDE: a steady unbroken burnt orange line running the full width of the cream stage

beats.change_only: the steady orange line extends past both edges

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a huge scatter of blank monochrome cards thrown across the cream stage all at once

beats.change_only: the scattered cards settle into a flat grey drift

beats.phrase: A search is not a sprint,
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure at the head of a neat queue of blank cards on the cream stage

beats.phrase: it is a queue you refill.
beats.change_only: the queue behind the figure lengthens and straightens
